objectives.text: Carry the military takeover of October 2025 to a civilian-branded exit. Col. Michael Randrianirina, a military leader, took over after the Gen Z protests (the Guardian headline of 15 October 2025: 'military leader set to be sworn in as president'). His two-year roadmap, released at the end of February 2026, sets consultations to the end of 2026, a new constitution, and presidential elections due in late 2027. In March 2026 he dismissed the prime minister and the cabinet without giving a reason, and the Gen Z movement voiced concern about the 'militarisation' of the regime.

grand_strategy.reading: Madagascar's grand strategy in 2026 is to turn a military takeover into a managed transition: an elected successor by late 2027, the African Union back in the room, and the Scattered Islands kept on the agenda against Paris. Its levers are the powers already present on the island: France, with the islands and an Élysée channel used in February 2026; China, its largest trading partner; the United States, whose AGOA preference is still in renewal; and the EU, whose budget aid, frozen since 2010, only began to thaw in November 2025. The paradox is that the officers who give the regime its strength are also why the AU, the donors and the protesters are not yet persuaded.

stances.note: Former colonial power and the partner Antananarivo keeps talking to, with an open grievance over the Scattered Islands. Partner is our reading: Malagasy coverage frames the February 2026 Paris trip as economic, which is transactional cooperation without alignment. The grievance is the sovereignty dispute: Macron refused restitution in April 2025 and the joint commission made no progress in June 2025. Trend stable. Madagascar stripped former president Rajoelina of Malagasy citizenship in October 2025, the reported ground being his French nationality; this adds friction but is not a stance on its own. Bond grievance is our reading of the dispute. Gap: the French side's view of Madagascar is not in the atlas yet, so nothing is mirrored; the FRA card is not written.
